title: VAL-PRE-001 evidence: value hypothesis missing
description: Structural measurability check only: a named metric, a numeric target with a direction, a baseline status, a named owner, and a business case id. This does not assess whether the hypothesis is a good one -- see docs/governance-contract.md and the control's own ASSESSMENT.md.

version.description: Only the currently implemented evidence-shape version is accepted. A future breaking change to this control's evidence shape bumps this const, not a version registry.

owner.description: Accountable Business Owner for this value hypothesis. No embedded line breaks.

businessCaseId.description: Traceability link to the organisation's business-case/intake process where this hypothesis was reviewed and agreed. No embedded line breaks -- this value crosses into deployment tags and must never be able to inject additional lines.
